page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, providing predictable compute performance. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents an entry-level GPU-accelerated option, balancing dedicated CPU cores and a modest GPU profile without the added cost of local storage. It is designed for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand massive parallel processing power or high-speed local disk access. Suitable applications include light machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic graphics rendering tasks.
